our_product_one_liner: An AI-powered revenue intelligence platform that sits on top of your existing CRM, reads call transcripts, emails, and pipeline data, and tells reps exactly what to do next on each deal. Average customer sees 23% lift in win rate within two quarters.
public_signals:
- Ramp announced a $150M Series D extension in September 2026 at a $16B valuation, led by Founders Fund. Press release emphasized 'disciplined growth' and 'unit economics' — a shift in tone from the 2024 'hypergrowth' messaging.
- CEO Eric Glyman on the Q3 Logan Bartlett podcast (Oct 2026): 'the single biggest lever for us next year is rep productivity — we have great top-of-funnel but our mid-funnel is where good deals go to die.' Mentioned they're 'rebuilding the revenue stack from the ground up.'
- 14 new sales roles posted on LinkedIn in the last 60 days, including 'Director, Revenue Enablement' and 'Senior Manager, Sales Analytics.' Both report into Marcus Okonkwo's org (based on org chart signals from LinkedIn).
- Marcus Okonkwo joined Ramp 4 months ago from Brex, where he led RevOps during their enterprise motion build-out. On his LinkedIn he describes his mandate at Ramp as 'operationalize the enterprise segment and get forecast accuracy above 85%.'
- Ramp's engineering blog published a post in October titled 'Why we're consolidating our go-to-market tooling.' Named Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, and 'three homegrown tools' they're actively reviewing.
- Glassdoor reviews from the last quarter mention 'constant pipeline reviews' and 'leadership is laser-focused on win rate right now.'
- Series D press release named three new independent board members, including the former CRO of Workday — a signal they're bringing in enterprise-sales DNA at the board level.
